# Code of Conduct

## Our standard

AegisDNS contributors and maintainers commit to a respectful, welcoming, and harassment-free project. Discuss ideas and code directly. Assume good intent, accept correction, and make technical criticism specific and constructive.

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, threats, discriminatory language, sexualized attention, deliberate intimidation, publishing another person's private information, or sustained disruption of project spaces.

## Project spaces

This policy applies to issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions, and other spaces where someone represents AegisDNS. Technical disagreement is welcome; personal attacks are not.

## Enforcement

Report conduct concerns privately to the maintainer using the contact method on [Harshil Anuwadia's GitHub profile](https://github.com/Harshil-Anuwadia). Do not include conduct reports in public issues. The maintainer may remove content, close conversations, reject contributions, or temporarily or permanently restrict participation when necessary to protect the community.

Reports will be handled with care and shared only as needed to investigate and respond. Retaliation against someone who reports a concern is prohibited.

## Attribution

This policy is informed by the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct.html).
